q: What does a Canadian aluminium smelter report for EU CBAM?
title: Canadian aluminium and EU CBAM
short: Direct emissions only: anode CO2, fuels and perfluorocarbons, per tonne of aluminium. Hydropower keeps indirect emissions low, but electricity is not charged for aluminium anyway. Canada prices carbon, so the importer may deduct the price effectively paid, after free allocation, with certified proof.
audience: Aluminium producers in Canada and their EU importers

p: Canada's industrial carbon pricing can reduce the CBAM bill, but only for the price actually paid after output-based allocation. Keep payment records and get them certified.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, power and production records into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions your EU importer asks for.
